`{details}`

The second line, when present, is hypothesis C1: the probe reused VeSync's known password-auth endpoint with the issued MFA challenge token and the advertised `otp` method, but sent no one-time code. Both lines are designed to be safe to paste into the project issue. Do not post screenshots containing your email address or any raw VeSync response.
result.title: VeSync authentication probe result

data_description.api_region: Use EU for accounts handled by the European VeSync service. Use GLOBAL for the US and other non-EU regions.
data_description.country_code: Two-letter ISO country code for the VeSync account, for example HU, DE, GB or US.
data_description.password: Used for the verified first-stage VeSync sign-in request only. It is not stored by the probe.
data_description.username: Email address used by the VeSync account. It is not stored by the probe.

user.description: This diagnostic tool runs beside Home Assistant's built-in VeSync integration. It performs the verified first-stage sign-in request. If VeSync returns an MFA challenge that advertises `otp`, the probe then tests one conservative continuation hypothesis against the same known endpoint without sending an OTP. It does not create entities, replace the built-in VeSync integration, exchange an authorization code for a session, or submit a one-time code.
user.title: Probe VeSync 2FA authentication
